cases.description: The average of a nonempty list of whole-number ratings retains its fractional part.
cases.buggy: fun ratingAverage(ratings: List<Int>): Double = (ratings.sumOf { it.toLong() } / ratings.size).toDouble()

cases.description: The maximum gap in an ascending list includes the final adjacent pair and defaults to zero for lists with fewer than two elements.
In a circular list of positive size, stepping backward from position zero lands at the final index.
cases.buggy:
fun wrappedCursor(position: Int, step: Int, size: Int): Int =
    ((position.toLong() + step) % size).toInt()
cases.fixed:
fun wrappedCursor(position: Int, step: Int, size: Int): Int =
    Math.floorMod(position.toLong() + step, size.toLong()).toInt()

cases.description: Area in square micrometers preserves products greater than the 32-bit integer limit.
cases.buggy: fun panelArea(widthUm: Int, heightUm: Int): Long = (widthUm * heightUm).toLong()
cases.fixed: fun panelArea(widthUm: Int, heightUm: Int): Long = widthUm.toLong() * heightUm

cases.description: Missing and whitespace-only captions both use the default label.
cases.fixed: fun displayCaption(value: String?): String = if (value.isNullOrBlank()) "Untitled" else value

cases.description: Two decimal measurement readings are equal when their numeric values match, including representations with different scales.
cases.buggy:
fun equalReadings(first: java.math.BigDecimal, second: java.math.BigDecimal): Boolean =
    first == second
cases.fixed:
fun equalReadings(first: java.math.BigDecimal, second: java.math.BigDecimal): Boolean =
    first.compareTo(second) == 0

cases.description: A monthly field report deadline is the last calendar day of the month following the supplied date.
A color tally counts every occurrence in the supplied list.
cases.buggy: fun colorOccurrences(colors: List<String>): Map<String, Int> = colors.associateWith { 1 }
cases.fixed: fun colorOccurrences(colors: List<String>): Map<String, Int> = colors.groupingBy { it }.eachCount()

cases.description: A collection of plants is fully labeled only when each plant has a nonblank label.
cases.buggy: fun allPlantsLabeled(labels: List<String>): Boolean = labels.any { it.isNotBlank() }
cases.fixed: fun allPlantsLabeled(labels: List<String>): Boolean = labels.all { it.isNotBlank() }

cases.description: The label length is the number of Unicode code points, including any supplementary character.
cases.fixed: fun labelCodePoints(label: String): Int = label.codePointCount(0, label.length)

cases.description: Exhibits are ordered by descending score, with names in ascending alphabetical order for ties.
cases.buggy:
data class ScoredExhibit(val name: String, val score: Int)

fun sortExhibits(exhibits: List<ScoredExhibit>): List<String> = exhibits
    .sortedWith(compareByDescending<ScoredExhibit> { it.score }.thenByDescending { it.name })
    .map { it.name }
cases.fixed:
data class ScoredExhibit(val name: String, val score: Int)

fun sortExhibits(exhibits: List<ScoredExhibit>): List<String> = exhibits
    .sortedWith(compareByDescending<ScoredExhibit> { it.score }.thenBy { it.name })
    .map { it.name }

cases.description: Bucket sort outputs sorted values without changing their multiplicities. Inputs are integers from zero up to but excluding the bucket count.
Calls that omit the tag list each start with an empty collection.
The function returns every positive sample in input order, including when its input is a one-shot iterator.
cases.fixed:
def positive_samples(samples):
    return [value for value in samples if value > 0]

cases.description: Each grid row is independently mutable.
cases.buggy:
def empty_grid(rows, columns):
    return [[0] * columns] * rows
cases.fixed:
def empty_grid(rows, columns):
    return [[0] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
cases.assertion:
grid = empty_grid(2, 2)
assert grid == [[0, 0], [0, 0]]
grid[0][1] = 7
assert grid == [[0, 7], [0, 0]]

cases.description: The default capacity applies to absent capacities, and an explicit capacity of zero is preserved.
Temperatures in degrees are sorted in numeric order while preserving the input array.
The function resolves to values produced by an asynchronous formatter in the order of the supplied names.
